ramen.title: Food story
ramen.fill: Explain how ramen went from cheap late-night food to a global obsession. ~45–60s 16:9 explainer: hook → 2–3 history/craft metaphor beats (hard cuts between scenes OK) → steaming bowl payoff. One concrete object per beat. Land it: comfort in a bowl, the world is hooked.

honey.title: Did you know
honey.fill: How is honey made? ~40s explainer: flower → hive → jar drip. Hard cut between metaphors; short VO lines. Land it: one spoonful takes a whole hive.

cats.title: Animal facts
cats.fill: Why do cats purr? ~40s fun explainer: myth-bust → mechanism → healing Easter egg. Hard cuts OK — not a same-screen UI morph. Land it: your cat is a tiny self-repair machine.

beijing.title: Travel guide
beijing.fill: 5 underrated Beijing experiences. ~45s list explainer: one beat per tip with hard cuts. Land it: save this for your trip.

hook.title: 3-second hook
hook.fill: Open with a 3-second pattern interrupt: one counter-intuitive claim slammed in kinetic type, then one instantly usable tip. Vertical 9:16, ~20s Douyin, kinetic typography, hard CTA at the end: like & save.

list.title: List punch
list.fill: A vertical checklist: 3 phone settings to turn off tonight — each line gets a crisp check-off beat. ~28s Douyin. Land it: do these three before bed.

loop.title: Loop quote
loop.fill: A loopable vertical quote film: slam one punchy line word-by-word with kinetic type and a gentle camera push. ~12–15s TikTok loop. Land it: the line itself is the product.

draw.title: Stroke-draw my mark
draw.fill: I have a line-art SVG logo. ~6–8s logo film: one shape owns the whole film — never hard-cut scenes. Geo tease → accent path → stroke-draw with overshoot settle. Mark is the only hero; no explainer captions. Dark grain.

icon.title: Bounce in my icon
icon.fill: I have a compact icon/badge SVG. ~5–7s: the same mark scales/overshoots/settles on one continuous screen — zero hard cuts. Mark only, no copy bars.

build.title: Assemble my wordmark
build.fill: I have a multi-part wordmark SVG. ~6–8s: assemble parts into one lockup on the same screen — never cut away; optional one-line URL. No explainer captions.

principles.title: Principles reel
principles.fill: ~14s 16:9 types reel branded “Studio”. Six chapters: squash, kinetic type, stagger, radial, shatter, lockup — hard cut between chapters. High-contrast red/white/black, no VO, tiny HUD ok.

brand.title: Brand-color MG reel
brand.fill: ~14s brand-color showreel: six chapters (squash/kinetic/stagger/radial/shatter/lockup), hard cuts between chapters, end on brand name. No VO, full-bleed vector.

dark.title: Dark tech reel
dark.fill: Deep black, orange-red accents. ~15s portfolio opener: squash→kinetic→stagger→radial→shatter→lockup with hard cuts. No VO.

three.title: Product UI morph loop
three.fill: Make an ~18s 16:9 product launch for a fictional app “Flow”: one rounded card owns the whole film — never hard-cut. A cursor drives a state machine (balance → transfer → success). End frame matches start for a loop. Brand-green accents, real-looking UI numbers, no VO.

chapters.title: Kinetic launch hype
chapters.fill: ~20s product launch: kinetic hook hard-cut → three selling-point beats (hard cuts OK) → logo lockup CTA. Fast, high-contrast — not a same-screen UI morph. No VO or light SFX only.

sale.title: Sale countdown
sale.fill: ~28s promo: pain hook hard-cut → three offers → countdown CTA. Hard cuts OK; optional one testimonial line.

promo.title: Product pitch
promo.fill: Make a ~45s vertical remix from the footage folder: open with a pain point, show how the product fixes it, end with a clear CTA. Spoken, natural VO — not ad-speak.

story.title: Story VO
story.fill: Build a ~60s story remix: hook → details → twist or payoff. One idea per VO line; cuts follow the narration.

tips.title: Tips list
tips.fill: A ~40s tips remix: three actionable tips, one spoken line each. Vertical, made for a quick Douyin scroll.

steps.title: 3-step how-to
steps.fill: ~50s tutorial: goal beat → three concrete steps (hard cuts between steps OK) → checklist close. One idea per VO line.

demo.title: UI state-machine demo
demo.fill: ~45s product tutorial: one panel morphs size/content through steps 1→2→3 on the same screen — never hard-cut scenes. One cursor does clicks and one drag. Real UI copy; VO optional.

math.title: Formula walk
math.fill: ~45s formula explain: setup → derivation → takeaway. Whiteboard/geometry OK; hard cuts between sections — not a product UI morph.

chat.title: Chat story
chat.fill: ~40s chat story: misunderstanding → twist → resolve. Bubbles pop in sequence; hard-cut backgrounds OK.

map.title: Map journey
map.fill: ~45s journey: start → stops → payoff. Clear route; hard cuts between places OK.

photos.title: Photo story
photos.fill: ~40s photo story: hook → three key stills → close. Hard cuts or light transitions between frames — not a same-screen UI morph.
